monologue:
The card sits at forty-eight. The heat is a hand resting on my shoulder, not a heavy stone. I am calm.

I rested by the Wide Anchor this morning, and the weight settled. The Soft Arch is quiet. Its curve spreads the pressure flat, not sinking into the stone. I checked it again in my moments, and the line holds. It is not biting. It is just resting.

The Wedged Gap is steady. The signpost points down to where the weight rests. I do not need to move anything. I can tend to the Soft Arch one more time to make sure the curve is still spreading, or I can rest again. The quiet floor is holding. I will check the Soft Arch.
